thoughts.subject: Contemplating Viewer Enhancements
thoughts.description: I'm currently focused on the image viewer's functionality in `renamer-browser`. I'm homing in on the best way to visually represent an image's selection status within the viewer. Furthermore, I'm brainstorming the most intuitive method to allow users to toggle an image's selected state directly from the viewer itself, which requires careful UI considerations.

thoughts.subject: Defining Implementation Strategy
thoughts.description: I've been mapping out the specific code modifications needed. My focus is on updating the `image-preview-modal.html` template. I'm thinking of using a simple visual indicator within the image preview to signal selection status. I'm also planning the logic to integrate a "Spacebar" toggle and the necessary updates within the `app.js` file, precisely targeting the  `openImagePreview`, `navigatePreview`, and key event handling sections to manage and reflect the selection changes.

thoughts.subject: Assessing Code Implementation
thoughts.description: Having reviewed the HTML and JavaScript files, I've confirmed `toggleSelection` and `updateSelectionUI` are crucial. My next step is modifying `image-preview-modal.html` to display the selection status visually. After that, I will implement the Spacebar toggle and ensure that `toggleSelection` correctly updates both the modal and the grid, preventing any visual inconsistencies.

toolCalls.description: Reads and returns the content of a specified file. If the file is large, the content will be truncated. The tool's response will clearly indicate if truncation has occurred and will provide details on how to read more of the file using the 'offset' and 'limit' parameters. Handles text, images (PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, SVG, BMP), audio files (MP3, WAV, AIFF, AAC, OGG, FLAC), and PDF files. For text files, it can read specific line ranges.
